rows.title_full: AN ACT TO RESTRUCTURE, RATIONALIZE, AND INTEGRATE THE GOVERNMENT´S LIVESTOCK INDUSTRY SUPPORT AGENCIES INTO THE PHILIPPINE LIVESTOCK AUTHORITY IN ORDER TO STRENGTHEN ITS DEVELOPMENT, PROTECTION, AND REGULATORY FUNCTIONS, INCLUDING THE PROMOTION OF DAIRY AND NATIVE ANIMALS, PROVIDE FOR A LIVESTOCK DEVELOPMENT FUND, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
rows.abstract:
Proposes for a 10-year roadmap of programs and projects for the propagation, utilization, and development of the livestock industry across administrative regions which shall cover every aspect of the business beginning from the breeding and feeding of animals to entrepreneurship.
Intends to activate under the PLA an Animal and Livestock Emergency Response Task Force (ALERT-TF); and to propose an initial fund for the purchase of facilities, socialized credit under the Small-hold Livestock Farm Modernization Program, research and development, international and local marketing assistance to small farmers, scholarship and human resource development grants for related courses, and infrastructure programs.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT PROMOTING PHILIPPINE INDIGENOUS AND TRADITIONAL WRITING
SYSTEMS AND PROVIDING FOR THEIR PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, AND
CONSERVATION
rows.title_short: Philippine Indigenous And Traditional Writing Systems Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to promote, protect, preserve, and conserve the Philippine indigenous and traditional writing systems as a means to inculcate patriotism and social consciousness among the citizenry.
Mandates the NCCA to be the lead agency in promulgating policy guidelines on the promotion of the writing systems and to protect, preserve, and conserve the writing systems as a national cultural treasures in accordance with R.A. No. 10066, otherwise known as the “National Cultural Heritage Act of 2009.”
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2022-11-28, transmitted to the Senate on 2022-11-29 and received by the Senate on 2022-11-29

rows.author: J024;
rows.title_full:
AN ACT PROMOTING THE GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT OF SOCIAL ENTERPRISES AS A MEANS TO ALLEVIATE POVERTY, ESTABLISHING FOR THE PURPOSE THE POVERTY REDUCTION THROUGH SOCIAL ENTREPRENEURSHIP (PRESENT) PROGRAM, CREATING THE SOCIAL ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL, PROVIDING SUPPORT,
BENEFITS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to create an environment that encourages the development, growth and sustainability of social enterprises by providing them with programs, financial support, resources, and incentives - as they improve the quality of life of specific segments of the marginalized and vulnerable sectors of society - for them to become effective workers, suppliers, clients and/or owners.  Intends to distribute to these sectors a substantive part of the wealth created by the Social Enterprises.

Defines Social Enterprise (SE) as a mission-driven organization that creates wealth while contributing to social well-being and ecological sustainability.  It can take the form of non-stock, non-profit corporations such as NGOs, POs, foundations, associations; cooperatives; and sole proprietorships, partnerships, and stock corporations.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT since 2022-11-16
